title: The house at 2119 Chippewa and the Irish Channel
summary: They discuss the family home, the upstairs balcony where the band played, and the Irish Channel neighbourhood near the river.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: 2119 Chapel Tula. Chapel Tula. That's where I was born. They're there too. In the same old house. Same old house.
And that balcony where they played, was that upstairs? Up high? Upstairs. Upstairs. And they played up high, didn't they?

Yes. A front balcony. I'll tell you, they entertained the whole neighborhood. And they were wonderful boys. Never got into trouble. Only among themselves. Never had arguments. If they did, it was indoors. But those children never caused any sorrow to that mother and father. That's a wonderful record for all boys. Yes. Just one girl, unless you married early.
Was that called the Irish Channel? Oh, we were in the middle of the Irish Channel.
I hate to say that, because all my children were raised there. I'm proud of it. I'm proud of it myself. But we... Oh, Lord.
There were a lot of good people. That's right. A lot of good. Self-made people. We were in the Jackson Avenue, you see.
But they lived the block out further.
We lived closer to the river.
The boats were right there close to you. Yes. They were closer. Closer than they are now.
